subject.title: fix: local gateway connections recover after listener or token drift

question: Should automatic repair be enabled by default only for positively identified setup-managed gateway records, with all legacy or manually configured localhost records remaining manual until explicit ownership is established?
rationale: The patch introduces a new default recovery and credential-gating policy for persisted gateway records. Source inspection shows the migration boundary is broader than the stated app-owned WSL scope, so maintainers must confirm the intended upgrade contract before a mechanical fix can be accepted.

options.title: Narrow migration to proven setup ownership
options.body: Persist setup-managed metadata only when setup state can prove the same endpoint and preserve all other migrated localhost records as manual.

options.title: Accept broad localhost adoption
options.body: Treat all migrated local endpoints as setup-managed and explicitly document that upgrade behavior, including repair and credential-gating consequences.

options.title: Split recovery from migration
options.body: Land listener safety separately and defer automatic repair adoption until the stored-record ownership model is agreed.

recommendation.title: Narrow migration to proven setup ownership
recommendation.body: Persist setup-managed metadata only when setup state can prove the same endpoint and preserve all other migrated localhost records as manual.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch design and its migration policy are concentrated in this contributor's recent implementation commits, although broader current-main ownership evidence remains limited.
